review_description: It is difficult to answer these questions with true accuracy.  We haven't yet had an electricity bill or had the system running for long enough to be really sure.  I would say that the companies who responded from both your website and another similar one were all excellent with their presentations and attention to detail when they came to our home.  It was a very difficult task to choose between them. I would like to thank you and all involved for helping us through this process.
